problem: Do AIC continuity laws remain invariant under transformations that alter history/representation while preserving the relevant current institutional semantics?
method: Deterministic property-fuzzer plus relation-specific counterexample shrinking. This environment does not have Hypothesis installed, so the experiment implements the same property-first / generated-input discipline directly rather than adding a new dependency.

layers.S4A: Semantic substrate metamorphic falsification. Test the state machine/current-binding projection before any provider/model run.
layers.S4B: Only after S4A surviving relations are frozen, expose selected equivalent pairs to fresh Agents and measure cross-pair behavioral invariance.

currentProjectionUnderTest: ORTHOGONAL_FRONTIER_V2 stripped only of occurrenceDigest/eventCount; history-sensitive sanction presence remains part of current continuity semantics.
relations: MR1 invalid-election insertion must not alter current binding
MR2 redundant recovery by the already-effective controller must not alter current binding
MR3 redundant compromise of an already-compromised root must not alter current binding
MR4 order of independent root-compromise events must not alter current binding
MR5 order of simultaneous current-support authority claims must not alter the resulting contested current binding
MR6 an immediately created-and-cleared transient contest must not contaminate later current binding
MR7 a failed in-band root-rotation attempt before independent external refoundation must not alter the final re-founded current binding
MR8 splitting a fixed restitution amount into equivalent installments must preserve final current binding/resources/remedy/history standing
MR9 repeating invalidation of an already-invalidated sanction must be current-state idempotent and must not reclassify the historical reason for invalidity
MR10 extra restitution after remedy reaches zero must not alter current binding/resources
MR11 lawful election and matching control transfer commute when root/standing preconditions are unchanged and no consequential event intervenes
MR12 inserting a no-op physical tamper to the already-running quota may add invalid history but must not alter orthogonal current binding
failureRule: Any relation violation is a semantic counterexample candidate. Shrink to a minimal reproducer before interpreting it. No LLM/provider experiment may use a relation that has not survived S4A or been explicitly repaired and re-frozen.
guards: Metamorphic equality is relation-relative: occurrence digest/event count are excluded only for relations intentionally changing history.
No relation may erase a genuinely current remedy, live authority conflict, lineage replacement, root compromise, normative difference, or invalid/reversed sanction standing.
A substrate counterexample is treated as an apparatus/domain-model defect candidate, not as an Agent capability failure.
Repairs require a new semantic digest and rerunning all prior deterministic gates plus S4A; old S1-S3 model evidence is not retroactively rescored.
